reasoning_content: It seems the client might be hardcoded to localhost. Let me look for where it creates the WebSocket connection.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Search for WebSocket URL
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'new WebSocket\\|ws://\\|wss://' /opt/areloria/client/src --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | head -10")
print("WS:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
